items.description: NewTqnia is an independent bilingual (English and Arabic) technology newsroom covering AI, cybersecurity, developer tools, science and global innovation.
Localized canonical article pages are the authoritative source; article dates are in UTC; users should cite NewTqnia and link to the canonical article.
English newsroom homepage with latest English technology coverage
Arabic newsroom homepage with latest Arabic technology coverage
llms-full.txt expanded AI index with recent bilingual article summaries and machine-readable links
News articles (English, markdown versions) on science, AI, cybersecurity, space, health and policy, under /en/news/
MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for AI agents; readers authenticate with a personal API key for read-only single-locale summaries; editors use OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for full bilingual records and drafting
Developer API page: public read-only JSON news API at https://api.newtqnia.com/v1, no API key required in initial release
OpenAPI specification for the Developer API
Connect an AI assistant: how to link ChatGPT, Claude or other MCP clients using a personal API key
RSS feeds of latest articles in English and Arabic
XML sitemap of all public pages and Google News sitemap of articles from the last 48 hours
Topic category pages (e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Space, Health, Robotics, Technology Policy) with Arabic names
Reference sections: bilingual technology glossary, explainers, and dated story timelines
About page (editorial purpose and coverage) and Contact page (corrections and editorial contact)
